title: LM Router 1.1.0
release_notes:
### 💬 Parallel Chats
• True parallel conversations: switch chats or compose new prompts without stopping an active stream
• Turns continue streaming in the background and persist cleanly to their own threads

### ⚡ Faster Tool Execution
• Decoupled UI updates from the agent loop for faster token, reasoning, and tool streaming
• Automatic trimming on oversized tool outputs to prevent context bloat and lag
• Snappy 45-second timeout on stalled models and cached token budgeting
• Fixed MCP file-content handling crashes and loop-crossing issues

### 🔧 Uncapped MCP Servers
• Removed all tool limits, swap-to-enable prompts, and overflow auto-disables
• Automatic connection testing and settled tool counts on adding a server
• Native shell and file-read tools on desktop; safe remote HTTP/SSE on mobile

### 🖥 Lifecycle & System Prompt
• Explicit exit confirmation dialog on window close (X) and Quit buttons
• Current date and time now injected into the system prompt by default
